audit_items.proof_trace: Multi-proof KZG quotient polynomial computation (compute_kzg_proof_multi) is not implemented in Prysm. All KZG cryptographic operations are delegated to external libraries (c-kzg-4844 and go-kzg-4844). The mathematical invariant f(X)=Q(X)*Z(X)+R(X) is enforced in the external C library, not in Prysm's Go wrapper code.
